category_source.description: Which candidate source resolved blog_category against the routing map: 'state' (state.json :: brief.category — no pipeline stage currently writes this), 'meta' (memory/workspace/{task_id}/meta.json :: categories[], the real signal written by meta-builder), or null when no candidate matched (fallback_used=true) or on the no-config sentinel.

resolved_service.comment: Null on the no-config sentinel (skipped_no_config=true); an object when a real brief was resolved.

skipped_no_config.description: True on the no-config sentinel: the project has no conversion_offers config, so no real brief was resolved and cta-writer must be skipped.

business_model.description: Present on the ecommerce path only (v3.38): lets downstream stages branch without re-reading business-context.json. The b2b path and the no-config sentinel omit it.

resolved_products.description: Ecommerce-path (business_model='ecommerce') resolution: the WooCommerce products/category the article's REAL content matched, plus the deterministically-assembled [products ...] shortcode (the LLM never builds it). Absent on the b2b path and the sentinel.

mode.description: ids = ≥1 product name matched verbatim in the body (up to 3, document order); category = keyword/title/H2 token-overlap matched a product category; fallback = default_category or a link-only shop brief.

ids.description: WooCommerce product IDs (ids mode only; else empty).

category_slug.description: Matched product-category slug (category or default-category fallback); null in ids mode and no-category fallback.

product_names.description: HTML-unescaped display names of the matched products (ids mode only; else empty).

shortcode.description: Fully-formed WooCommerce [products ...] shortcode WordPress expands at page-view time. null in the no-category fallback (link-only brief), OR when a matched category/default_category slug fails the charset guard (see `warning`).

warning.description: Present only when a defense-in-depth guard suppressed part of the resolution (v3.38 Task 4): a matched category slug failed the [a-z0-9%-]+ charset guard (shortcode withheld), or a SKU-verbatim match had zero products with a valid integer catalog id (fell through to category matching). Absent on a clean resolution.

constraints.description: Per-project cta-writer/tone constraints copied verbatim from conversion_offers.constraints (v3.38). Known keys: no_person_blocks (bool), tone (string), banned_phrases (array). Default {} when unset.
